tooltip.anyastorage.flat_screen_tv.1: Place on a table or floor to watch your linked outdoor camera.
tooltip.anyastorage.flat_screen_tv.2: Sneak-use a camera-linked tablet on the TV to connect it.
tooltip.anyastorage.outdoor_camera.1: Wall cameras follow moving hostile mobs. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand for target settings.
tooltip.anyastorage.outdoor_camera.2: Right-click with an empty hand to swivel. Sneak-use a tablet here, then on a monitor to link.
tooltip.anyastorage.wall_monitor.1: Place on a wall. Sneak-use the tablet that selected your outdoor camera to link it.
tooltip.anyastorage.wall_monitor.2: Look at the screen to watch. Right-click with an empty hand to resize it or choose mobs.
tooltip.anyastorage.wall_monitor.3: Fits up to 3 × 3 blocks. Use Fit wall to expand over a clear surface.
tooltip.anyastorage.wall_monitor.4: Click + or - for one block, or type a width or height and press Enter.
tooltip.anyastorage.wide_wall_monitor.1: A flat screen up to 9 × 5. Place against a wall and sneak-use a camera-linked tablet.
tooltip.anyastorage.wide_wall_monitor.2: Right-click to fit the wall, change size or choose tracking targets.
tooltip.anyastorage.wide_wall_monitor.3: Click + or - for one block, or type a width or height and press Enter.
Fits up to 32 × 32 blocks, including an entire clear Skygrid wall.
Place on a wall, link with a tablet, then right-click and choose Fit wall.
Click + or - for one block, or type a width or height and press Enter.
tooltip.anyastorage.sky_camera.1: Place outdoors on a solid surface. Its lens always looks straight up.
tooltip.anyastorage.sky_camera.2: Inside Skygrid open the tablet, then Cosmetics and Live ceiling. Sneak-use your tablet on a different Sky Camera to choose it.
tooltip.anyastorage.backpack.1: Right-click to open. Sneak-right-click in air to manage upgrades.
tooltip.anyastorage.backpack.2: Sneak-right-click the ground to place it, then use patches or upgrades on it.
tooltip.anyastorage.backpack.3: Sneak-right-click with empty hands to pick the bag up.
tooltip.anyastorage.backpack.4: Backpacks and filled portable containers cannot go inside.
tooltip.anyastorage.backpack.5: Wear it from the Wardrobe or use an Accessories back slot when available.
tooltip.anyastorage.remote.1: Carry or use this old remote to turn it into a Cupid Tablet with the same binding.
tooltip.anyastorage.remote.2: Use the converted tablet in air within its hub's radius to open storage.
tooltip.anyastorage.cupid_tablet.1: Sneak-right-click a permitted hub to bind. Right-click in air within its radius to open storage.
tooltip.anyastorage.cupid_tablet.2: Sneak-right-click your Skygrid Cube to link its pocket. Right-click the cube to visit.
tooltip.anyastorage.cupid_tablet.3: Use the tablet inside the linked room for storage. Edit Mode requires Build permission.
tooltip.anyastorage.cupid_tablet.4: Owners can sneak-right-click a chest in hub range to edit its routing.
tooltip.anyastorage.creative_tablet.1: Sneak-right-click a permitted hub to bind. Right-click in air from any distance or dimension.
tooltip.anyastorage.creative_tablet.2: Works in Survival. The hub's storage permissions still apply.
tooltip.anyastorage.creative_tablet.3: Sneak-right-click your Skygrid Cube to link its pocket. Right-click the cube to visit.
tooltip.anyastorage.creative_tablet.4: Use the tablet inside the linked room for storage. Edit Mode requires Build permission.
tooltip.anyastorage.creative_tablet.5: Owners can sneak-right-click a chest in hub range to edit its routing.
tooltip.anyastorage.ancient_technology.1: Right-click to read the illustrated storage guide and this server's recipes.
tooltip.anyastorage.ancient_technology.2: Lost your copy? When recovery is enabled, /anya guide recover costs one ordinary book.
tooltip.anyastorage.hub.1: Connects nearby containers so you can search their contents with a tablet.
tooltip.anyastorage.hub.2: Place it near your storage, then sneak-right-click it with a tablet to bind.
tooltip.anyastorage.hub.3: As owner, right-click the hub to manage access or upgrade its radius.
tooltip.anyastorage.chest.1: Stores items in 54 slots. Place it and right-click to open.
tooltip.anyastorage.chest.2: Place it within your hub's radius to include it in tablet searches.
tooltip.anyastorage.chest.3: The owner can change its front symbol from the chest menu.
tooltip.anyastorage.uwu_cube.1: Stores items in 216 slots. Place it and right-click to open.
tooltip.anyastorage.uwu_cube.2: Place it within your hub's radius to include it in tablet searches.
tooltip.anyastorage.home_void_cube.1: Entrance to an experimental room. The server must enable pocket storage for visits.
tooltip.anyastorage.home_void_cube.2: Sneak-right-click it with a hub-bound tablet to link. Right-click to enter with Visit permission.
tooltip.anyastorage.home_void_cube.3: Look at any face for a room illustration. With View permission, a loaded room can show its chest layout.
tooltip.anyastorage.home_void_cube.4: Check Ancient Technology for the server's current pocket settings.
tooltip.anyastorage.keepsake_shelf.1: A glass globe for one keepsake. Right-click with an item to display one.
tooltip.anyastorage.keepsake_shelf.2: Right-click with an empty hand to take it back. Claim and pocket permissions apply.
tooltip.anyastorage.delivery_hatch.1: Holds nine parcels. Look at your placed hatch and use /anya furniture invite <player>.
tooltip.anyastorage.delivery_hatch.2: Invited senders can right-click with a stack to deliver it.
tooltip.anyastorage.delivery_hatch.3: As owner, sneak-right-click with an empty main hand to collect a parcel.
